name: @nuckty/core
description: All static site generators suck. This one just sucks less. BEMJSON template engine, programmatic pipeline, multi-target builds.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run build:types && npm run build:js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && rm -rf .coverage && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=$PWD/.coverage node --test --import ./config/register-test-source.mjs src/test/*.test.ts src/test/integration/*.test.ts config/*.test.mjs && node config/filter-coverage.mjs && c8 report --temp-directory .coverage-source --all --exclude-after-remap --include 'src/**/*.ts' --exclude 'src/test/**' --exclude 'src/**/*.d.ts' --exclude 'src/bem/template-types.ts' --exclude 'src/index.ts' --reporter text --reporter json-summary --reports-dir coverage && node config/check-coverage.mjs coverage/coverage-summary.json
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit -p config/config-ts-test.json && npm run lint:openspec && npm run lint:markdown
